owner_instruction.context: Given in reply to the two findings recorded in docs/M2-SCOPE-PROPOSAL.md section 8 and reports/m2-step-1-build-record-2026-09-26.json: the analogue minimum (5) sat below the mean/median reporting minimum (10), so most analogue sets that existed could not themselves carry a mean or median.
owner_instruction.nothing_else_changed: No other policy value, and no code, changed as part of this instruction.

effect.fingerprints: None. nre/fingerprints.py never reads the analogues policy block, so no fingerprint statistic changes. Regenerating reports/m2-fingerprints-2026-09-26.json only changes its stamped policy.sha256, because every report stamps the whole policy file's hash.

analogues_found_by_label_before_min_5_af.note: Counts are how many of the 23 accepted events, treated as a historical target at its own cutoff, get an ANALOGUES_FOUND state for that label. Computed directly from the code, not estimated.

mean_or_proportion_reported_among_found_.before: Only some found sets reached the mean/median or proportion reliability minimum of 10, since the analogue minimum (5) was below it: 3, 1, 1, 2 and 1 of the 13, 12, 11, 8 and 4 found sets carried a mean, for day1/session2/5/10/20 respectively.
mean_or_proportion_reported_among_found_.after: Every found set now carries a mean, because the analogue minimum (10) equals the mean/median reporting minimum: 6/6, 4/4, 4/4, 3/3 and 1/1 for the same five labels.
mean_or_proportion_reported_among_found_.verified: Recomputed directly: for every label and every found set, the summary's mean (or, for gap flags, proportion) state is never WITHHELD after this change.

effect.new_side_effect_worth_flagging: The two conditional gap labels (positive_gap_retained_half, positive_gap_filled) now have zero targets with a found analogue set, down from 7. They exist for only 12 of the 23 events (an opening gap of at least 0.5% is required), and reaching 10 matured, eligible, in-range analogues from a pool that thin, on top of self- and cluster-exclusion, is harder than for the unconditional labels. This is a direct, verified consequence of the same instruction, not a separate decision.

not_regenerated: reports/m2-step-1-build-record-2026-09-26.json is left as the record of the 2026-09-26 build; this file is the record of the 2026-09-27 amendment on top of it.
tests_updated: tests/test_analogues.py (two tests that exercised the prior default of 5 directly now pin 5 explicitly with a policy override, since that is what they are illustrating and not the production default; the real-data found-count test now expects the counts above)
not_changed: Milestone 1 records, protocol, code or the frozen cohort.
The confirmed scope in docs/M2-SCOPE-PROPOSAL.md; this is an amendment on top of it, recorded the same way config/pilot.json records its own 2026-09-23 amendment.
